latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Skill Surge Notifier
- Monitors ClawHub for rapidly growing skills, tracking downloads and stars
- Detects surges based on growth percentage, total downloads, star count, or top 10 appearance
- Includes CLI commands for fetching data, running surge checks, managing profiles, and configuring thresholds
- Supports running automatically via crontab and allows environment variable overrides for customization
